method: Measured landmarks, corrected wrist/paw depths and fitted tail cross-sections; continuous chain weights, three mesh-edge smoothing passes, four influences maximum. Distal hand/toe clipping, 0.00001-unit source welding and simple boundary-loop caps; 28 extra digit joints with independent rigid geometry. Context-guarded limb morphs selected from elbow, knee, shoulder and hip candidates with attachment-preserving fur offsets from constrained edge-length fitting; original weights and rest surface unchanged. Character-specific, not automatic anatomical inference.

poseCorrections.method: Fur tufts translate with their body attachment, preserving their existing triangle shape. Pose-space corrective morphs from projected edge-length fitting; original weights, joints and rest geometry preserved.
limits: Accepted individual and sampled combined poses only; not arbitrary motion.
No collision, volume or final design approval.
Disabled after changes to skin weights or bind skeleton.
No morph correspondence between the two independently reconstructed meshes.
Articulated paws replace distal source surfaces; no final design or collision approval.
Landmark skinning and surface refinement require visual review; source reconstruction defects can remain.
